name: Meet-ups
description: Speakers and panels — and sometimes someone jumps up with an impromptu pitch. Then we all argue about it over a drink.

name: Co-building sessions
description: Bring your own project and work on it alongside other people doing the same. Quiet focus, loud breaks.

name: Workshops
description: Hands-on learning sessions. Laptops open, something working by the end.

name: Networking
description: Cafe catch-ups and Friday night drinks. No agenda, no slides.

name: Pop-ups
description: Someone interesting is in town, office hours with someone useful, or something just happened that we all need to talk about. Short notice, worth it.

name: Big events
description: Conferences, hackathons, anniversary parties, and pitch nights that are deliberately a bit silly. Less frequent, worth clearing your calendar for.

name: Touch grass
description: Bush walks and the AI run club. Genuinely a recurring thing, not just an idea we had once.
